record_scope_reconstruction: On May 29, 2024 farmers moved from the Reynosa–Río Bravo road at Ejido Palo Blanco toward the Pharr crossing. Northbound circulation from Reynosa into the US stopped briefly and resumed about 17:30. The original gathering road and the interrupted border crossing must not be conflated.

source_checks.finding: Full KRGV article inspected: May 30 report refers to Wednesday protest; northbound bridge circulation closed for minutes, initial gathering at Ejido Palo Blanco, resumption about 17:30.
Direct OSM XML inspected: separate Mexican toll plaza, customs buildings and international road alignment. Map sha256 c28e38c8e72fa9d37676252aa89e81d9dd529e4b7c563aabb0c11ecb42ce4385.
